author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Want to run powerful AI directly on your own computer for free? In this video, I’ll show you exactly how to set up Google’s Gemma 4 on your PC step by step using LM Studio.

With just a few clicks, you can install the model, run it locally, and start using it for real tasks like summarizing notes, extracting action items, and more. The best part? Everything runs on your machine, so your data stays private and you don’t need any subscriptions.

If you’ve ever wanted to use AI offline or avoid paying for tools like ChatGPT, this is one of the easiest ways to get started.
title: How to Run Google Gemma 4 on Your PC (Free)
